name: Party Identification 79
definition: Set of elements used to identify an account owner and the associated decision maker.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Identifies the account which is used to acquire or sell financial instruments.

DecisionMaker.name: Decision Maker
DecisionMaker.definition: Identifies the person who makes the decision on the financial instrument, acquire in case the of a buyer or to sell in case of the seller.
